name: SNV Uganda
summary: SNV is a global development organisation working on agri-food systems, energy access, and water, sanitation & hygiene in Uganda, supporting smallholders and enterprises to build inclusive and sustainable livelihoods.
description: SNV Netherlands Development Organisation has operated in Uganda since the 1980s, delivering market-based solutions that connect smallholder farmers, agri-enterprises, and energy service providers to inclusive value chains. In partnership with government and the private sector, SNV Uganda's Energy programme supports the deployment of productive use of energy (PUE) technologies — including solar-powered irrigation, agro-processing machinery, and biodigesters — to reduce post-harvest losses, improve food security, and increase farm incomes. SNV is a key implementer and technical advisor on several donor-funded agri-energy initiatives, including projects supported by the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs, EU, and USAID.
